name: MusicBrainz Album Subset (10k Releases)
description: Subset of the MusicBrainz dataset covering more than 10,000 different albums (releases). Releases are described by attributes such as title, artist, release date, release country, and the list of tracks contained on the album. Some attribute values are missing or incorrect. The dataset is provided as XML and uses the MusicBrainz MMD 2.0 namespace.

variableMeasured.name: id
variableMeasured.description: MusicBrainz-derived record identifier for the music release

variableMeasured.name: artist
variableMeasured.description: Artist or group credited for the release

variableMeasured.name: release-date
variableMeasured.description: Release date normalized to YYYY-MM-DD where available

variableMeasured.name: release-country
variableMeasured.description: Country where the release was published

variableMeasured.name: duration
variableMeasured.description: Total duration of the release in seconds

variableMeasured.name: label
variableMeasured.description: Record label associated with the release where available

variableMeasured.name: genre
variableMeasured.description: Primary genre associated with the release where available

variableMeasured.name: tracks
variableMeasured.description: List of track titles on the release
